content.text:
I did not get into the cellar. The door is locked and can't be picked, and I can't travel to the person who holds its key, so I stopped and handed in my notes.

- **Getting in:** I slipped unseen through the yard trapdoor into the cellar guardroom. Pickpocketing Sakeeus-Wan and the gaoler Tsleel-Vaku found nothing.
- **The gaoler:** Tsleel-Vaku says he carries no key and that Never-Writes-Twice keeps it. His one hint was "They sleep, and they dream. That is all they do down there." The game said I got that line on a pass; the topics themselves list the checks as Speech 50 and Illusion 25.
